name: Sasurai no Ryourinin
source:
Protagonist is a world-wide known chef. This time he decides to cook for two weeks a western mansion on an isolated island. Six girls volunteer to assist him there.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一位享譽世界的廚師。這一次，他決定前往孤島上的西式宅邸，掌廚兩週。六名少女自願隨行，在那裡擔任他的助手。

[內容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
